name: Kanoso
source:
Slapstick parody of Key's Kanon ([url=/v33]Kanon[/url]).

You play as 17-year-old Yuuichi Aizawa (木目沢ネ右一). Having trained in this madder-red city and left on a ascetic travel, you return to your hometown to determine who is the strongest...

[Translated from [url=http://yellow-paper.hp.infoseek.co.jp/game/kanoso.html]YELLOW PAPER[/url]]
translation:
对Key作品[url=/v33]《Kanon》[/url]的闹剧式戏仿。

玩家扮演17岁的相泽右一（木目沢ネ右一）。你曾在这座深红之城修行，之后踏上苦行之旅，如今回到故乡，只为确定谁才是最强者……

[翻译自[url=http://yellow-paper.hp.infoseek.co.jp/game/kanoso.html]YELLOW PAPER[/url]]
